title: posts.json
description: Generated by the ingestion agent. Do not hand-edit. The agent MUST validate against this file before committing; on any validation failure it commits nothing and files a GitHub issue instead.

version.description: Bump only alongside a breaking change to this schema.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the run that produced this file, RFC 3339.

window_days.description: Retention window in effect for this run, copied from config.json.

source_url.description: Index or feed URL the posts were discovered from.

posts.description: Sorted by published_at descending. Every id must be unique.

id.description: Stable slug derived from the post URL path. Must not change once assigned.

published_at.description: Publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. If the source gives only a coarse date, use it verbatim; never invent precision.

tldr.description: Agent-written summary, grounded in body_text only. NOTE: the word bounds in config.tldr are a quality rule enforced by the runbook, NOT by this schema. A TL;DR outside those bounds still validates here and must be rewritten in-run, never escalated as a validation failure.

body_text.description: Plain-text article body. No markup, no navigation chrome, no footer boilerplate.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of body_text. Drives change detection across runs.
